mechanism: Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine) antagonizes dopamine agonist effects by serving as a cofactor for aromatic amino acid decarboxylase, which can reduce ropinirole's therapeutic efficacy in treating Parkinson's disease.
action: Avoid concurrent use of high-dose vitamin B6 (>10-25 mg/day); monitor for reduced ropinirole efficacy if supplementation is necessary and consider alternative B6 sources or dosing adjustment.
